scheme_name: Awarding of Tamil Mamani, Telugu Ratna and Malayala Ratna
other_conditions: Applicant must not have received any similar award from other government bodies or organizations such as universities.
Applicant must participate in literary and research activities.
Applicant must be a native of Puducherry or have continuously resided in Puducherry for at least 5 years.
benefits_summary: Provides a cash award of ₹75,000 to each eligible author/writer.
